subject: [hw] IP -> lead: P04 objects are in build_ios; registration gate text for n2vt_shim.c
body:
P04 objects are now part of gpu/hwcodec/build_ios.sh: INCS adds -I gpu/hwcodec/vt and it compiles annexb.c, n2hwenc_vt.c, n2hwenc_client.c, n2hwenc_register.c into /tmp/n2hw-ip/ios/obj (10280/22552/3544/2688 bytes, arm64 ios16, -Werror). They are handed to gpu/video through PLUGIN_OBJS, not linked into vcodecd.

Registration: I agree with P04/R2 that n2_register_all() should gate the call until M4c. Proposed exact lines for gpu/video/vt/n2vt_shim.c (not my file):
  extern int n2hwenc_register_all(void) N2_WEAK;   /* P04 */
  ...
  if (n2hwenc_register_all != NULL && access(N2VT_SWITCH_CLAIM_HW, F_OK) == 0)
      n2vt_say("hardware encoders registered: %d", n2hwenc_register_all());

Using N2VT_SWITCH_CLAIM_HW avoids a new frozen constant; the object itself stays unconditional. This is the F32 mitigation P04 filed; build-side only remains IP and it is done.

No phone claim from me; hardware encoder selection stays unqualified until M4c.
